sloka: ऋश्यमूकम् गिरि वरम् भार्या हरण दुःखितः ।प्रविष्टो अस्मि दुराधर्षम् वालिनः कारणान्तरे ॥४-१०-२८॥
transliteration: ṛśyamūkam giri varam bhāryā haraṇa duḥkhitaḥ ।praviṣṭo asmi durādharṣam vālinaḥ kāraṇāntare ॥4-10-28॥

translations.english: 'Tormented by the abduction of my wife by Vali, I came to the great Rishyamuka mountain inaccessible to Vali for some other reason.
